TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-209
STEP 1. Check the park/neutral position switch.
Q: Is the park/neutral position switch in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 2.
NO : Repair it. The park/neutral position switch "R" position 
signal should be able to be checked and the rear 
wiper should work normally.
STEP 2. Check the park/neutral position switch power 
supply circuit at the park/neutral switch connector B-41.
(1) Disconnect park/neutral position switch connector B-41 and 
measure at the harness side.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 8 and ground.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Go to Step 3.
